name: W Melbourne
insider_take: Melbourne's most electrifying luxury playground where cutting-edge design meets Australia's cultural capital.
whats_special: W Melbourne occupies floors 76-80 of Australia Place, making it one of the Southern Hemisphere's highest hotels. The property features stunning 360-degree views of Port Phillip Bay and the city skyline, while its Living Room lobby on the 76th floor serves as Melbourne's highest cocktail bar. The hotel's bold interiors showcase contemporary Australian art and design, perfectly capturing Melbourne's avant-garde spirit.
pro_tip: Book a Spectacular Room on the bay side for unobstructed sunset views over Port Phillip Bay – the golden hour from this height is absolutely magical and perfect for Instagram-worthy shots.
dont_miss: The hotel's proximity to Collins Street's luxury shopping precinct and being just steps from Melbourne's famous laneways filled with street art, hidden bars, and world-class coffee culture. The building also houses high-end retail and dining on lower floors, making it a destination in itself within Melbourne's business district.
pros: Prime Collins Street location in Melbourne's cultural and shopping district
Signature W Hotels contemporary design with bold aesthetics and modern amenities
Rooftop bar and premium dining venues with city views
Full-service spa and state-of-the-art fitness facilities
cons: Urban setting may have limited outdoor space
Premium pricing reflects luxury brand positioning
